page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.g7 server family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an x86_64 architecture Intel Xeon 8369B processor. The instance features 128 dedicated vCPUs operating at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz, paired with 512.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a balanced resource ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The lack of integrated local storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a tradeoff, positioning this instance strictly for non-accelerated, network-dependent workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.32xlarge offers high resource density within the general-purpose hardware class, providing a massive pool of dedicated compute and memory resources without the premium cost associated with specialized GPU or high-RAM configurations. It is suited for enterprise-grade applications, large-scale web serving, containerized microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and general-purpose database hosting where balanced compute and memory are required.
